title: PV Sindhu to Partner Tanisha Crasto in Asian Games Women's Doubles
indian_angle: Indian fans will be keen to see how two-time Olympic medalist PV Sindhu performs in a new women's doubles partnership at the Asian Games.
summary: PV Sindhu is set to play women's doubles with Tanisha Crasto at the Asian Games 2026, a rare occurrence for the singles specialist. She will also compete in singles, opening her campaign against Akane Yamaguchi.

title: BAI Advanced Coaches Course Underway in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This course aims to enhance the skills of Indian badminton coaches, directly impacting the future talent pipeline.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) is conducting a Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course at its National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14 to 23, 2026.

title: New Regulations Issued for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: These regulations are crucial for the smooth conduct and fair play of one of India's key domestic team badminton tournaments.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has released new regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and guidelines for participating teams.

title: Women's Doubles Pair Change for World Junior Championships Trials
indian_angle: This update impacts the selection process for India's women's doubles contingent at the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: A change has been announced regarding a women's doubles pair for the selection trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026, affecting the final team composition.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp Held in Guwahati
indian_angle: This coaching camp is vital for preparing India's promising U17 and U15 junior players for the upcoming Badminton Asia Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp for the Indian U17 and U15 junior badminton teams was held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, preparing them for the Badminton Asia Junior Championships 2026.
